description: C12 0 Flood Prone Hazard Areas Code is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Hobart Open Data. Potential Flood areas for all Hobart catchments. METHODOLOGY: Modelled Flood Areas - 2100 1% Annual Exceedance Probability (Modelled areas of all Hobart waterways including Hobart, New Town and Sandy Bay rivulets and minor drainage lines). Additional areas may be subject to flooding. Site specific investigation may be required for each property. Coverage: City of Hobart Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher City of Hobart Open Data. Its tags are development, environmental, flood, flood-prone, inundation. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
